subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 26, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has seen another significant refinement with the implementation of relative symlinks for the latest.iso, allowing it to resolve correctly on the host web root, and this improvement is now live on our website at https://acreetionos.org/. This follows closely on the heels of our recent update to use per-pipeline staging directories, which has greatly reduced the likelihood of publish races between concurrent builds.

Development
The latest updates to our CI pipeline are a testament to the community's dedication to refining and stabilizing our workflow, ensuring that users receive the most up-to-date and stable versions of AcreetionOS. As always, our changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html is the best place to stay informed about the latest developments and updates to the project.

Community
The broader Linux ecosystem has also seen some interesting developments, with the release of Emacs 31.1 and the latest stable kernel set, including versions 7.1.10 and 6.18.46. For more information on how to get the most out of AcreetionOS, including tips on using these new kernel versions, be sure to check out our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html and our wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html. Additionally, our flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html is a great resource for staying up-to-date on the latest news and updates from the project.
